Context: Not eligible:-

- Grant of advance for payment of fees for training in Hindi
9. Typewriting/ Stenography at private institutions.-
- (1) Employees eligible for lumpsum awards on passing Hindi Typewriting/ Stenography may be granted advance of z 100/z 200 respectively.
- (2) Amount of advance limited to 6 months fees for Typewriting and
- 12 months fees for Stenography training.
- (3) Advance to be granted after three months of admission in the private institution and after obtaining certificate about regular attendance/
